review_note:
Checked line by line: test file, helper, manifest. All sha256 values match the current files. The console log shows 164 passed, 0 failed, 0 skips, and 'Julia bridge: 10 live tests ran'. Counts reconcile (24 for the Tweedie hand-density block, plus 5 x 13 intercept and 5 x 15 slope = 164). Totoro native rerun gave 24 passed / 0 failed / 10 skipped. The 24 is exactly the Tweedie hand-density block, which passes natively against tweedie::dtweedie (1e-6) and total mass (1e-5). The 10 live routes skip because Totoro has no Julia, so live counts rest on the Mac log, which I did not rerun.

Per family. (1) Cumulative logit (int and slope) and Tweedie intercept: agreement 2e-10, effectively exact against the 1-D integral oracle. Tweedie is independent of the package (hand series, cross-checked to CRAN tweedie). Seeds are irrelevant here. (2) Beta-binomial (int and slope), hurdle NB2 (int and slope), truncated NB2 slope, ZIP intercept: agreement 9e-5 to 8.8e-4. The scan shows these families carry systematic quadrature error: beta-binomial slope 1.2e-3 to 5.5e-3 at SD 0.3 (the fixture used log 0.15), hurdle slope up to 3e-2, hurdle intercept up to 9e-3, truncated slope up to 6.7e-3, ZIP intercept up to 4.4e-3. The hurdle slope (8.8e-4) and truncated slope (8.8e-4) fixtures sit just under the 1e-3 tolerance, and the seeds were picked from six. Granted for likelihood assembly (hand density, hurdle/truncation, beta-binomial overdispersion, selector alignment, per-level SD indexing) at the fixture, not for quadrature accuracy. Errors up to 3e-2 are small against gaps of 1 to 9, so I judge the rows not misleading. (3) ZIP slope: UNSUPPORTED. At the default SD the scan gives 1.1e-2, 1.5e-2 and 2.4e-2 on three of six draws and 0.12 on one, and the pass came from choosing both seed 20261101 and a halved SD (log 0.15). The 0.12 departure is 120 times the tolerance. A reviewed row would hide an engine-side accuracy gap.

Other criteria. Oracles are hand-written base R (exact per-group trapezoid integral; hand densities). Hurdle is truncated_nbinom2() plus hu ~ 1, which is the package's own spelling (R/drmTMB.R line 12060), and ZIP is poisson() plus zi ~ 1. Both match the row family labels. Emulated bugs are asserted above 0.1, observed at 0.72 or more. Each linked row is fitted as one independent scalar field through (1 | id) or (0 + x | id) with sd(id[, coef = 'x']) ~ z, matching the iid layouts.

Does NOT establish: quadrature accuracy of the Julia iid routes on other draws or SD levels; ZIP slope behaviour at the default SD; anything for slope routes at SD above the fixture's; calibration, coverage, SEs; native/Julia parity; DRM.jl source identity beyond its recorded head commit; other seeds.
